rowText: After the small models finish, read text_model_routing_order over SSH: the new model(s) should be AFTER gemma4:e2b-it-qat. Quote the list.

build.commit: 96538e1 (branch experimental, working tree at run time)

settingsBefore.note: set to this one-entry list in step 1 via the plugin's own try-order screen; the screen actually saved both installed models at the time (see plan61-day2 driver report), so the real starting value for this step was ['gemma4:e2b-it-qat', 'nomic-embed-text:latest']

steps.press: Ticked qwen2.5:1.5b in the pull picker, then pressed A on 'Pull selected (1) · 0.9 GB'
steps.expected: qwen2.5:1.5b downloads and is appended to the saved text try order after the models already in it
steps.actualResult: Download ran 14:15:37-14:16:03 (986 MB in about 26s, roughly 40-44 MB/s per the log's own speed readout). Dialog closed itself once the download finished.

steps.press: Read text_model_routing_order over SSH after the download finished
steps.expected: gemma4:e2b-it-qat first, qwen2.5:1.5b appended at the end
steps.actualResult: text_model_routing_order = ['gemma4:e2b-it-qat', 'nomic-embed-text:latest', 'qwen2.5:1.5b']. gemma4:e2b-it-qat stayed first and qwen2.5:1.5b was appended at the very end, after nomic-embed-text:latest.

verdictSentence: When a small model finished downloading, the app added it to the bottom of the list of models it tries first, exactly as it should for an ordinary-sized model.
notes: gemma3:1b, which was downloaded earlier and unexpectedly (see plan61-PULL-MISSING-NAME-01.json), was NOT added anywhere in text_model_routing_order even though it is installed. That model's pull did not go through the normal Pull selected path, which may be why the merge-on-pull step never ran for it. Worth a look outside this row: an installed model that never made it into the try list is invisible at Ask time.
